home.heading: Training and markets, open to apply
home.intro: The Municipality runs free training courses and rural markets for people who farm, keep livestock, or make and sell food. Anything open to apply for is listed here. You do not need an account.
home.count: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing open at the moment} one {# opportunity open} other {# opportunities open}}
home.emptyBody: There are no courses or markets taking applications today. New ones are added through the year — check back, or ask at the Municipality office.
home.loadFailed: The list could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.

typeHint.training: Learn a skill. Open to anyone.
typeHint.advisory: One-to-one advice. You need to have completed a training course first.
typeHint.exhibition: Sell what you produce at a municipal market. Open to anyone.
